title: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.07256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparsity and quantization reduce the cost of attention by skipping interactions and lowering the precision of those retained. However, useful interactions differ in their precision requirements: some tolerate low-precision scores while remaining sensitive to removal. We therefore introduce TriAttention, which assigns query-key (QK) tiles to skipping, 4-bit, or 8-bit computation, using 4-bit to retain quantization-tolerant interactions at lower cost. To represent compactly, we encode each head's computation regions with two diagonal-distance boundaries, keeping policy storage independent of context length. Offline calibration then evaluates candidate boundary pairs using normalized projected-output errors and complete-tile execution costs. Using these measurements, a model-wide allocator selects each head's boundaries to minimize calibration error under a shared computation budget. translated_title: TriAttention：面向长上下文LLM推理的统一稀疏混合精度注意力机制
translated_abstract: 稀疏化和量化通过跳过部分交互以及降低所保留交互的精度来降低注意力机制的计算成本。然而，有用的交互对精度的需求各不相同：有些交互能够容忍低精度评分，但对被移除却十分敏感。因此，我们提出了TriAttention，它将查询-键（QK）分块分配给跳过、4位或8位三种计算方式，利用4位计算以更低的成本保留那些可容忍量化的交互。为了实现紧凑表示，我们使用两个对角距离边界来编码每个注意力头的计算区域，使策略存储与上下文长度无关。随后，离线校准过程使用归一化投影输出误差和完整分块执行成本来评估候选边界对。基于这些测量结果，一个模型级分配器在共享计算预算下为每个注意力头选择边界，以最小化校准误差。在预填充阶段，所选边界会生成精确……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: TriAttention提出了一种统一的稀疏混合精度注意力方法，通过离线校准为每个注意力头在跳过、4位和8位计算之间分配计算区域，在共享计算预算下兼顾稀疏性与量化精度，从而优化长上下文LLM推理的成本与精度平衡。
